1. Find the roots of \(f(x)=x^2+x-6\):
\[
x^2+x-6=(x+3)(x-2),
\]
so the roots are
\[
x=-3,\quad x=2.
\]

2. From the graph of \(g(x)\), the \(x\)-intercepts are at
\[
x=-1,\quad x=3.
\]

3. Comparing the root sets:
\[
\{-3,2\}\quad \text{and}\quad \{-1,3\}
\]
have no roots in common.

\[
\boxed{\text{C. } f \text{ and } g \text{ share no roots in common.}}
\]
